name: Chesapeake city, VA
findings: Chesapeake city has 682 nonprofit organizations. 283 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 232 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Chesapeake city has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 22 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do professional organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 72 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?
